Xl: its keys are NONE, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE; rendering.js, application.js and player.js pass `Xl.INFO` and `Xl.DEBUG` to `logger.isEnabled`; the logger's help text calls the number the "global log level"
Jl: maps none, error, warn, info, debug, trace to the level numbers; `setLevel` looks a name up in it (help text: "set global log level (none/error/warn/info/debug/trace)")
Ql: inferred: the text printed in brackets in front of a debug or trace line (`[DEBUG]`, `[TRACE]`), by level number
ed: inferred from its last resort, the text "[undescribable]": a short text for one value of a log call
ad: its result is stored under the key `message` of a breadcrumb; "format" is inferred

_H: tests `kind === "inferno"` on what inferno/controls.js calls `encounterSnapshot`; Grid.js calls it with `state.encounter` of a frame before it reads `state.wave` and `state.startSpawnLayout`
